scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dir='dist/ChroniCaree-Frontend'; const candidates=[dir+'/index.html', dir+'/browser/index.html', dir+'/index.htm']; let found=false; for(const inFile of candidates){ if(fs.existsSync(inFile)){ try{ fs.copyFileSync(inFile, dir+'/200.html'); console.log('200.html created at', dir+'/200.html'); }catch(e){} try{ const browserOut = dir + '/browser/200.html'; if(fs.existsSync(dir + '/browser') || inFile.includes('/browser/')){ fs.copyFileSync(inFile, browserOut); console.log('200.html also created at', browserOut); } }catch(e){} found=true; break; } } if(!found){ console.warn('index.html not found at', JSON.stringify(candidates)); }"
